attempts.bug_summary: The generated visitor methods for less-than and greater-than predicates are paired with the opposite comparison operators. This causes generated filters to invert those two inequality predicate types while leaving the rest of the generated class unchanged.

The generated Eq and NotEq visitor methods are associated with the opposite predicate logic. This causes equality predicates to behave as inequality predicates and vice versa in the generated builder.

attempts.bug_summary: The generated footer-key metadata is sourced from the uniform-key configuration value rather than the resolved footer key identifier. Uniform encryption continues to work because the footer identifier is assigned from that value, but non-uniform encryption produces incorrect metadata.

The column-metadata AAD is built with the row-group ordinal and column ordinal interchanged. This causes footer-key metadata decryption to fail whenever the row-group and column ordinals differ, while leaving cases where the ordinals happen to match unaffected.
